Xander: The name of that harmless, shiny little pony that kiddies ride on at the show, on the merry-go-round. As a pixie in a previous life, he's working up to be store-front mannequin in the next one, before he steps into the realm of a fully-fledged human after that. And he'll get there too and we're lucky to have him because Xander hasn't got an evil bone in his body.
Xavier: A private school boy and all round nice guy. He won’t set the world on fire but he won’t bore us to death either. Probably.
